integrity: All claimed finite cases were checked by self-contained integer/finite-field arithmetic; the infinite range is proved algebraically with an elliptic Hasse bound. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact sign histogram applies in odd characteristic at least five; characteristic three has a separate obstruction and characteristic two is excluded.
The global finite-field classification rests on Hasse’s inequality together with exhaustive exact checks at nineteen eligible fields of order below 71.
Potential implicit prior equivalence in specialized elliptic-character-sum literature has not been ruled out by independent priority review.
title: One elliptic trace controls cyclotomic quadratic-sign triples and their sharp prime-power threshold
